package.description: ETL and automation hub for data engineers and non-technical teams

en-US.description: ETL and automation hub for data engineers and non-technical teams
en-US.longDescription: EasyMorph Hub is an ETL and automation hub for data engineers and non-technical teams. It runs workflows created in EasyMorph Desktop and hosts projects and spaces so teams can share and automate data transformation. EasyMorph Hub comes only in a 64-bit version and only for Windows.
en-US.name: EasyMorph Hub

zh-CN.description: 面向数据工程师和非技术团队的 ETL 与自动化中心
zh-CN.longDescription: EasyMorph Hub 是面向数据工程师和非技术团队的 ETL 与自动化中心。它运行 EasyMorph Desktop 创建的工作流，并托管项目和空间，让团队能够共享和自动化数据转换。EasyMorph Hub 仅提供 64 位版本，且仅适用于 Windows。
